name: Wayfinder
description: Chisel navigation marks into cave walls, floors, and ceilings — arrows, explored, danger, resources, home, water, dead end, cache, and translocator markers etched directly into the rock. Hold a chisel without a hammer and Sneak+Right-Click any rock surface. Cycle mark types with Ctrl+U; an icon beside the hotbar shows the selected mark while you hold a chisel.
